/**
 * FloorPlanHeightControl
 *
 * Controls architectural wall height and thickness.
 * FloorPlanBuilder remains the authoritative owner.
 */
class FloorPlanHeightControl {
    constructor(container, builder, onCommit = null) {
        if (!container || !builder) {
            throw new Error(
                "Wall controls require a container and builder."
            );
        }

        this.container = container;
        this.builder = builder;
        this.onCommit = onCommit;

        this.element = document.createElement("section");

        Object.assign(this.element.style, {
            display: "grid",
            gap: "9px",
            margin: "12px 0",
            padding: "12px",
            background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.07)",
            borderRadius: "6px"
        });

        this.element.innerHTML = `
            <strong>ARCHITECTURAL WALLS</strong>

            <label>
                Wall height
                <output data-value="height"></output>
                <input data-setting="height"
                    type="range"
                    min="2.4"
                    max="1000"
                    step="0.1">
                <input data-number="height"
                    type="number"
                    min="2.4"
                    max="1000"
                    step="0.1">
            </label>

            <label>
                Wall thickness
                <output data-value="thickness"></output>
                <input data-setting="thickness"
                    type="range"
                    min="0.1"
                    max="1000"
                    step="0.1">
                <input data-number="thickness"
                    type="number"
                    min="0.1"
                    max="1000"
                    step="0.1">
            </label>

            <small>
                Thickness controls the horizontal depth
                of generated walls.
            </small>
        `;

        const buildButton =
            container.querySelector("#build-floor");

        if (buildButton) {
            buildButton.after(this.element);
        } else {
            container.appendChild(this.element);
        }

        this.controls = {
            height: {
                slider: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-setting="height"]'
                ),
                number: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-number="height"]'
                ),
                output: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-value="height"]'
                ),
                setter: value =>
                    builder.setWallHeight(value),
                initial: builder.wallHeight
            },
            thickness: {
                slider: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-setting="thickness"]'
                ),
                number: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-number="thickness"]'
                ),
                output: this.element.querySelector(
                    '[data-value="thickness"]'
                ),
                setter: value =>
                    builder.setWallThickness(value),
                initial: builder.wallThickness
            }
        };

        for (const [name, control] of Object.entries(
            this.controls
        )) {
            control.slider.value = control.initial;
            control.number.value = control.initial;

            control.slider.addEventListener(
                "input",
                () => {
                    control.number.value =
                        control.slider.value;

                    this.updateLabel(name);
                }
            );

            control.number.addEventListener(
                "change",
                () => {
                    control.slider.value =
                        control.number.value;

                    this.commit(name);
                }
            );

            control.slider.addEventListener(
                "change",
                () => this.commit(name)
            );

            this.updateLabel(name);
        }
    }

    updateLabel(name) {
        const control = this.controls[name];

        control.output.textContent =
            `${Number(control.slider.value).toFixed(1)} units`;
    }

    commit(name) {
        const control = this.controls[name];

        try {
            const value = Number(control.number.value);

            if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
                throw new Error("Invalid wall dimension.");
            }

            control.setter(value);

            control.slider.value = value;
            control.number.value = value;

            this.updateLabel(name);
            this.onCommit?.(name, value);

        } catch (error) {
            console.error(
                "[FloorPlanHeightControl]",
                error
            );

            control.slider.value =
                String(control.initial = (
                    name === "height"
                        ? this.builder.wallHeight
                        : this.builder.wallThickness
                ));

            control.number.value = control.slider.value;

            this.updateLabel(name);
        }
    }

    dispose() {
        this.element.remove();
    }
}

export { FloorPlanHeightControl };


src/editor/floor-plan-reference.js

/**
 * FloorPlanReference
 *
 * Manages an independently positioned architectural
 * reference image in the Somnium building editor.
 *
 * Authoritative coordinates remain in simulation space.
 * SpatialTransform handles rendering coordinates.
 *
 * Babylon CreateGround uses local X-Z dimensions.
 */
class FloorPlanReference {
    constructor(scene, spatialTransform) {
        this.scene = scene;
        this.transform = spatialTransform;

        this.mesh = null;
        this.material = null;
        this.texture = null;
        this.objectURL = null;
        this.image = null;

        this.width = 20;
        this.depth = 20;

        this.opacity = 0.65;
        this.visible = true;

        this.position = {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            z: 0
        };

        this.altitudeOffset = 0;
        this.rotation = 0;
        this.loaded = false;
    }

    validatePosition(position) {
        if (
            !position ||
            !Number.isFinite(position.x) ||
            !Number.isFinite(position.y) ||
            !Number.isFinite(position.z)
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid floor-plan position."
            );
        }
    }

    async load(file) {
        if (
            !file ||
            typeof file.type !== "string" ||
            !file.type.startsWith("image/")
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Please select a valid image file."
            );
        }

        this.remove();

        try {
            this.objectURL = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            this.image = new Image();

            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                this.image.onload = resolve;
                this.image.onerror = () => reject(
                    new Error(
                        "Could not load floor-plan image."
                    )
                );

                this.image.src = this.objectURL;
            });

            if (
                !this.image.naturalWidth ||
                !this.image.naturalHeight
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Floor-plan image has invalid dimensions."
                );
            }

            this.texture = new BABYLON.Texture(
                this.objectURL,
                this.scene,
                false,
                false,
                BABYLON.Texture.TRILINEAR_SAMPLINGMODE
            );

            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                if (this.texture.isReady()) {
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }

                this.texture.onLoadObservable.addOnce(resolve);

                this.texture.onError = message => {
                    reject(
                        new Error(
                            message ||
                            "Floor-plan texture failed."
                        )
                    );
                };
            });

            this.material = new BABYLON.StandardMaterial(
                "building-floor-plan-material",
                this.scene
            );

            this.material.diffuseTexture = this.texture;
            this.material.emissiveTexture = this.texture;
            this.material.disableLighting = true;
            this.material.backFaceCulling = false;
            this.material.alpha = this.opacity;
            this.material.transparencyMode =
                BABYLON.Material.MATERIAL_ALPHABLEND;

            this.mesh = BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateGround(
                "building-floor-plan",
                {
                    width: 1,
                    height: 1,
                    subdivisions: 1
                },
                this.scene
            );

            this.mesh.material = this.material;
            this.mesh.isPickable = false;
            this.mesh.receiveShadows = false;
            this.mesh.renderingGroupId = 1;

            this.mesh.metadata = {
                type: "floor-plan-reference",
                reference: true
            };

            this.loaded = true;

            this.setVisible(this.visible);
            this.updateTransform();

            return this;

        } catch (error) {
            this.remove();
            throw error;
        }
    }

    async readPixels() {
        if (!this.image || !this.loaded) {
            throw new Error(
                "Load a floor-plan image first."
            );
        }

        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");

        canvas.width = this.image.naturalWidth;
        canvas.height = this.image.naturalHeight;

        const context = canvas.getContext("2d", {
            willReadFrequently: true
        });

        if (!context) {
            throw new Error(
                "Image processing canvas unavailable."
            );
        }

        context.drawImage(this.image, 0, 0);

        return context.getImageData(
            0,
            0,
            canvas.width,
            canvas.height
        );
    }

    setPosition(position) {
        this.validatePosition(position);

        this.position = {
            x: position.x,
            y: position.y,
            z: position.z
        };

        this.updateTransform();
    }

    setAltitudeOffset(offset) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(offset)) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid altitude offset."
            );
        }

        this.altitudeOffset = offset;
        this.updateTransform();
    }

    setDimensions(width, depth) {
        if (
            !Number.isFinite(width) ||
            !Number.isFinite(depth) ||
            width <= 0 ||
            depth <= 0
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid floor-plan dimensions."
            );
        }

        this.width = width;
        this.depth = depth;

        this.updateTransform();
    }

    setRotation(rotation) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(rotation)) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid floor-plan rotation."
            );
        }

        this.rotation = rotation;
        this.updateTransform();
    }

    updateTransform(
        position = this.position,
        dimensions = {},
        rotation = this.rotation
    ) {
        if (!this.mesh) return;

        if (!this.transform) {
            throw new Error(
                "SpatialTransform is unavailable."
            );
        }

        if (position) {
            this.validatePosition(position);

            this.position = {
                x: position.x,
                y: position.y,
                z: position.z
            };
        }

        const width = dimensions.width ?? this.width;
        const depth = dimensions.depth ?? this.depth;

        if (
            !Number.isFinite(width) ||
            !Number.isFinite(depth) ||
            width <= 0 ||
            depth <= 0 ||
            !Number.isFinite(rotation)
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid floor-plan transformation."
            );
        }

        this.width = width;
        this.depth = depth;
        this.rotation = rotation;

        const worldPosition = {
            x: this.position.x,
            y: this.position.y + this.altitudeOffset,
            z: this.position.z
        };

        const rendered = this.transform.worldToRender(
            worldPosition
        );

        const cos = Math.cos(rotation);
        const sin = Math.sin(rotation);

        const xAxis = this.transform.transformDirection(
            worldPosition,
            {
                x: cos,
                y: 0,
                z: -sin
            }
        );

        const zAxis = this.transform.transformDirection(
            worldPosition,
            {
                x: sin,
                y: 0,
                z: cos
            }
        );

        const xScale = Math.hypot(
            xAxis.x,
            xAxis.y,
            xAxis.z
        );

        const zScale = Math.hypot(
            zAxis.x,
            zAxis.y,
            zAxis.z
        );

        if (
            !Number.isFinite(xScale) ||
            !Number.isFinite(zScale) ||
            xScale <= 0 ||
            zScale <= 0
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid projected floor-plan dimensions."
            );
        }

        this.mesh.position.set(
            rendered.x,
            rendered.y + 0.08,
            rendered.z
        );

        // CreateGround occupies local X-Z, not X-Y.
        this.mesh.scaling.set(
            width * xScale,
            1,
            depth * zScale
        );

        // Align the ground plane to its projected X axis.
        const projectedYaw = Math.atan2(
            -xAxis.z,
            xAxis.x
        );

        this.mesh.rotation.set(
            0,
            projectedYaw,
            0
        );

        this.mesh.isVisible = this.visible;
        this.mesh.computeWorldMatrix(true);
    }

    setOpacity(value) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
            throw new Error(
                "Invalid floor-plan opacity."
            );
        }

        this.opacity = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(1, value)
        );

        if (this.material) {
            this.material.alpha = this.opacity;
        }
    }

    setVisible(value) {
        this.visible = Boolean(value);

        if (this.mesh) {
            this.mesh.setEnabled(this.visible);
        }
    }

    toggleVisibility() {
        this.setVisible(!this.visible);
        return this.visible;
    }

    remove() {
        this.mesh?.dispose();
        this.material?.dispose();
        this.texture?.dispose();

        this.mesh = null;
        this.material = null;
        this.texture = null;

        if (this.objectURL) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(this.objectURL);
            this.objectURL = null;
        }

        this.image = null;
        this.loaded = false;
    }

    dispose() {
        this.remove();
    }
}

export { FloorPlanReference };
export default FloorPlanReference;

class CelestialSystem {
    constructor(scene, options = {}) {
        this.scene = scene;

        this.dayLength = options.dayLength ?? 900;
        this.timeScale = 1;
        this.elapsed = options.initialTime ?? 0;

        this.orbitDistance = options.orbitDistance ?? 45000;
        this.skyRadius = options.skyRadius ?? 90000;
        this.sunSize = options.sunSize ?? 1800;
        this.moonSize = options.moonSize ?? 1300;

        this.sunLight = options.sunLight ??
            new BABYLON.DirectionalLight(
                "celestialSunLight",
                new BABYLON.Vector3(0, -1, 0),
                scene
            );

        this.ambientLight = options.ambientLight ??
            new BABYLON.HemisphericLight(
                "celestialAmbientLight",
                new BABYLON.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
                scene
            );

        this.moonLight = new BABYLON.DirectionalLight(
            "celestialMoonLight",
            new BABYLON.Vector3(0, -1, 0),
            scene
        );

        this.sunLight.diffuse =
            new BABYLON.Color3(1.0, 0.94, 0.78);

        this.sunLight.specular =
            new BABYLON.Color3(1.0, 0.95, 0.85);

        this.moonLight.diffuse =
            new BABYLON.Color3(0.48, 0.58, 0.85);

        this.moonLight.specular =
            new BABYLON.Color3(0.35, 0.42, 0.65);

        this.sunDirection = new BABYLON.Vector3();
        this.moonDirection = new BABYLON.Vector3();

        this.daylight = 0;
        this.twilight = 0;
        this.starVisibility = 1;

	// Initialize rendering resources before the first update.
this.createSky();

// Initialize the celestial simulation and shader uniforms.
this.update(0);

console.log("[CelestialSystem] Initialized.");

        console.log("[CelestialSystem] Initialized.");

    // -----------------------------------------
    // ATMOSPHERIC SKY
    // -----------------------------------------

    createSky() {
        BABYLON.Effect.ShadersStore[
            "somniumSkyVertexShader"
        ] = `
            precision highp float;

            attribute vec3 position;

            uniform mat4 world;
            uniform mat4 worldViewProjection;

            varying vec3 vDirection;

            void main(void) {
                vec4 worldDirection =
                    world * vec4(position, 0.0);

                vDirection = normalize(worldDirection.xyz);

                gl_Position =
                    worldViewProjection * vec4(position, 1.0);
            }
        `;

        BABYLON.Effect.ShadersStore[
            "somniumSkyFragmentShader"
        ] = `
            precision highp float;

            varying vec3 vDirection;

            uniform vec3 sunDirection;
            uniform vec3 moonDirection;

            uniform float daylight;
            uniform float twilight;
            uniform float starVisibility;
            uniform float time;

            float hash31(vec3 p) {
                p = fract(p * 0.1031);
                p += dot(p, p.yzx + 33.33);
                return fract(
                    (p.x + p.y) * p.z
                );
            }

            void main(void) {
                vec3 direction = normalize(vDirection);

                float height = clamp(
                    direction.y,
                    -1.0,
                    1.0
                );

                // Daytime atmospheric colors.

                vec3 zenithDay = vec3(
                    0.16, 0.42, 0.78
                );

                vec3 horizonDay = vec3(
                    0.65, 0.79, 0.92
                );

                // Nighttime atmospheric colors.

                vec3 zenithNight = vec3(
                    0.003, 0.006, 0.022
                );

                vec3 horizonNight = vec3(
                    0.018, 0.027, 0.065
                );

                float horizon = pow(
                    1.0 - max(height, 0.0),
                    2.0
                );

                vec3 daySky = mix(
                    zenithDay,
                    horizonDay,
                    horizon
                );

                vec3 nightSky = mix(
                    zenithNight,
                    horizonNight,
                    horizon
                );

                // Blend day and night.

                vec3 sky = mix(
                    nightSky,
                    daySky,
                    daylight
                );

                // Sunrise and sunset palette.

                vec3 sunsetZenith = vec3(
                    0.24, 0.10, 0.25
                );

                vec3 sunsetHorizon = vec3(
                    1.0, 0.24, 0.065
                );

                vec3 sunset = mix(
                    sunsetZenith,
                    sunsetHorizon,
                    pow(horizon, 0.65)
                );

                float sunsetBand = exp(
                    -pow(height * 5.0, 2.0)
                );

                sky = mix(
                    sky,
                    sunset,
                    twilight * sunsetBand
                );

                // Sun disc and atmospheric glow.

                float sunDot = dot(
                    direction,
                    normalize(sunDirection)
                );

                float sunDisc = smoothstep(
                    0.99965,
                    0.99985,
                    sunDot
                );

                float sunGlow = pow(
                    max(sunDot, 0.0),
                    24.0
                );

                vec3 sunColor = mix(
                    vec3(1.0, 0.22, 0.06),
                    vec3(1.0, 0.91, 0.68),
                    daylight
                );

                sky += sunColor *
                    sunGlow *
                    (0.12 + twilight * 0.35);

                sky = mix(
                    sky,
                    sunColor,
                    sunDisc
                );

                // Procedural star field.

                vec3 starCell = floor(
                    direction * 550.0
                );

                float starRandom = hash31(starCell);

                float star = step(
                    0.9985,
                    starRandom
                );

                float starBrightness = mix(
                    0.45,
                    1.0,
                    hash31(starCell + 17.3)
                );

                float twinkle = 0.85 +
                    0.15 * sin(
                        time * 2.0 +
                        starRandom * 40.0
                    );

                float stars = star *
                    starBrightness *
                    twinkle *
                    starVisibility;

                vec3 starColor = mix(
                    vec3(0.55, 0.68, 1.0),
                    vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.86),
                    starRandom
                );

                sky += starColor * stars;

                // Subtle lunar glow.

float moonDot = dot(
    direction,
    normalize(moonDirection)
);

float moonDisc = smoothstep(
    0.99972,
    0.99988,
    moonDot
);

float moonGlow = pow(
    max(moonDot, 0.0),
    18.0
);

vec3 moonColor = vec3(0.78, 0.83, 0.96);

sky += vec3(0.12, 0.16, 0.30)
    * moonGlow
    * starVisibility
    * 0.3;

sky = mix(
    sky,
    moonColor,
    moonDisc * starVisibility
);
                gl_FragColor = vec4(sky, 1.0);
            }
        `;

        this.skyMesh =
            BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateSphere(
                "somniumAtmosphere",
                {
                    diameter: this.skyRadius * 2,
                    segments: 32
                },
                this.scene

        this.skyMaterial =
            new BABYLON.ShaderMaterial(
                "somniumSkyMaterial",
                this.scene,
                {
                    vertex: "somniumSky",
                    fragment: "somniumSky"
                },
                {
                    attributes: ["position"],
                    uniforms: [
                        "world",
                        "worldViewProjection",
                        "sunDirection",
                        "moonDirection",
                        "daylight",
                        "twilight",
                        "starVisibility",
                        "time"
                    ]
                }
            );

        this.skyMaterial.backFaceCulling = false;
        this.skyMaterial.disableDepthWrite = true;
        this.skyMaterial.fogEnabled = false;

        this.skyMaterial.setVector3(
            "sunDirection",
            this.sunDirection
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setVector3(
            "moonDirection",
            this.moonDirection
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setFloat("daylight", 0);
        this.skyMaterial.setFloat("twilight", 0);
        this.skyMaterial.setFloat("starVisibility", 1);
        this.skyMaterial.setFloat("time", 0);

        this.skyMesh.material = this.skyMaterial;
        this.skyMesh.isPickable = false;
        this.skyMesh.infiniteDistance = false;
        this.skyMesh.alwaysSelectAsActiveMesh = true;

        this.skyMesh.renderingGroupId = 0;
    }

	
    // -----------------------------------------
    // VISIBLE SUN
    // -----------------------------------------

    createSun() {
        this.sunMesh =
            BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateSphere(
                "visibleSun",
                {
                    diameter: this.sunSize,
                    segments: 24

                this.scene

        this.sunMaterial =

        this.sunMaterial.specularColor =

        this.sunMaterial.disableLighting = true;

        this.sunMesh.material = this.sunMaterial;
        this.sunMesh.isPickable = false;
        this.sunMesh.renderingGroupId = 1;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------

    // -----------------------------------------

    createMoon() {
        this.moonMesh =
            BABYLON.MeshBuilder.CreateSphere(
                "visibleMoon",
                {
                    diameter: this.moonSize,
                    segments: 24
                },
                this.scene
            );

        this.moonMaterial =
            new BABYLON.StandardMaterial(
                "visibleMoonMaterial",
                this.scene
            );

        this.moonMaterial.diffuseColor =

        this.moonMaterial.emissiveColor =
            new BABYLON.Color3(0.16, 0.19, 0.28);

        this.moonMaterial.specularColor =
            new BABYLON.Color3(0.2, 0.2, 0.25);

        this.moonMaterial.disableLighting = true;

        this.moonMesh.material = this.moonMaterial;
        this.moonMesh.isPickable = false;
        this.moonMesh.renderingGroupId = 1;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------
    // TRANSITION FUNCTIONS
    // -----------------------------------------

    smoothstep(min, max, value) {
        const t = BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(
            (value - min) / (max - min),
            0,
            1
        );

        return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------
    // DAY/NIGHT UPDATE
    // -----------------------------------------

    update(deltaSeconds) {
        if (
            !Number.isFinite(deltaSeconds) ||
            deltaSeconds < 0
        ) {
            return;
        }

        this.elapsed +=
            deltaSeconds * this.timeScale;

        const phase =
            (this.elapsed / this.dayLength) *
            Math.PI * 2 +
            Math.PI / 2;

        const horizontal = Math.cos(phase);
        const vertical = Math.sin(phase);

        this.sunDirection.set(
            horizontal,
            vertical,
            0
        ).normalize();

        this.moonDirection.copyFrom(
            this.sunDirection
        ).scaleInPlace(-1);

        // Directional light directions.

        this.sunLight.direction.copyFrom(
            this.sunDirection
        ).scaleInPlace(-1);

        this.moonLight.direction.copyFrom(
            this.moonDirection
        ).scaleInPlace(-1);

        // -------------------------------------
        // LIGHT INTENSITIES
        // -------------------------------------

        this.daylight = this.smoothstep(
            -0.12,
            0.28,
            vertical
        );

        const moonlight = this.smoothstep(
            -0.12,
            0.28,
            -vertical
        );

        this.sunLight.intensity =
            1.5 * this.daylight;

        this.moonLight.intensity =
            0.22 * moonlight;

        this.ambientLight.intensity =
            BABYLON.Scalar.Lerp(
                0.10,
                0.52,
                this.daylight
            );

        // -------------------------------------
        // ATMOSPHERIC TRANSITIONS
        // -------------------------------------

        this.twilight =
            1.0 - this.smoothstep(
                0.015,
                0.28,
                Math.abs(vertical)
            );

        this.starVisibility =
            1.0 - this.smoothstep(
                -0.18,
                0.12,
                vertical
            );

        // -------------------------------------
        // UPDATE SKY AND CELESTIAL POSITIONS
        // -------------------------------------

const camera = this.scene.activeCamera;

if (camera) {
    this.skyMesh.position.copyFrom(camera.position);

    // Keep the sky inside the camera far plane.
    const farPlane = camera.maxZ || 100000;

    const effectiveRadius = Math.min(
        this.skyRadius,
        farPlane * 0.45
    );

    const skyScale =
        effectiveRadius / this.skyRadius;

    this.skyMesh.scaling.setAll(skyScale);
}

        // -------------------------------------
        // UPDATE SKY SHADER
        // -------------------------------------

        this.skyMaterial.setVector3(
            "sunDirection",
            this.sunDirection
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setVector3(
            "moonDirection",
            this.moonDirection
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setFloat(
            "daylight",
            this.daylight
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setFloat(
            "twilight",
            this.twilight
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setFloat(
            "starVisibility",
            this.starVisibility
        );

        this.skyMaterial.setFloat(
            "time",
            this.elapsed
        );

        // Nighttime fallback clear color.

        this.scene.clearColor =
            new BABYLON.Color4(
                0.003,
                0.006,
                0.022,
                1
            );
    }

    // -----------------------------------------
    // TIME CONTROLS
    // -----------------------------------------

    setTimeScale(scale) {
        this.timeScale =
            BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(scale, 0, 100);
    }

    setDayLength(seconds) {
        this.dayLength = Math.max(60, seconds);
    }

    setTimeOfDay(normalizedTime) {
        this.elapsed =
            BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(
                normalizedTime,
                0,
                1
            ) * this.dayLength;

        this.update(0);
    }

    getTimeOfDay() {
        return (this.elapsed / this.dayLength) % 1;
    }

    // -----------------------------------------
    // DEBUG INFORMATION
    // -----------------------------------------

    getStats() {
        return {
            timeOfDay: this.getTimeOfDay(),
            dayLength: this.dayLength,
            timeScale: this.timeScale,
            daylight: this.daylight,
            twilight: this.twilight,
            starVisibility: this.starVisibility,
            sunIntensity: this.sunLight.intensity,
            moonIntensity: this.moonLight.intensity,
            sunDirection: this.sunDirection.asArray(),
            moonDirection: this.moonDirection.asArray()
        };
    }

    // -----------------------------------------
    // CLEANUP
    // -----------------------------------------
dispose() {
    if (this.skyMesh) {
        this.skyMesh.dispose();
    }

    if (this.skyMaterial) {
        this.skyMaterial.dispose();
    }

    // Retain compatibility if independent celestial
    // meshes are reintroduced in a future implementation.
    this.sunMesh?.dispose();
    this.moonMesh?.dispose();
    this.sunMaterial?.dispose();
    this.moonMaterial?.dispose();

    this.sunLight?.dispose();
    this.moonLight?.dispose();
    this.ambientLight?.dispose();
}
}

class Environment {

    constructor(lightDirection) {

        this.sunDirection = lightDirection
            .negate()
            .normalize();

        // Environmental lighting configuration
        this.baseLight = 1.0;

        this.minimumLight = 0.12;

        // How strongly surrounding trees reduce light
        this.shadingStrength = 0.85;

        // Spatial grid for efficient canopy sampling
        this.canopyCellSize = 10;

        this.canopyGrid = new Map();
    }


    getCellKey(x, z) {

        const cx = Math.floor(x / this.canopyCellSize);
        const cz = Math.floor(z / this.canopyCellSize);

        return `${cx},${cz}`;
    }


    rebuildCanopyGrid(trees) {

        this.canopyGrid.clear();

        for (const tree of trees) {

            if (!tree.alive) continue;

            const age = tree.ageFactor;

            if (age < 0.1) continue;

            const height =
                tree.species.trunkLength *
                age *
                tree.genome.maxHeight;

            const radius =
                height *
                tree.species.canopy.width *
                tree.genome.canopyWidth;

            const key = this.getCellKey(
                tree.position.x,
                tree.position.z
            );

            if (!this.canopyGrid.has(key)) {
                this.canopyGrid.set(key, []);
            }

            this.canopyGrid.get(key).push({
                x: tree.position.x,
                z: tree.position.z,
                radius,
                height
            });

        }

    }

sampleLight(position) {

    const key = this.getCellKey(
        position.x,
        position.z
    );

    const cell = this.canopyGrid.get(key) || [];

    let shade = 0;

    for (const canopy of cell) {

        // Ignore canopies that are below the sample
        if (canopy.height <= position.y) continue;

        const dx = position.x - canopy.x;
        const dz = position.z - canopy.z;

        const distanceSquared =
            dx * dx + dz * dz;

        const radiusSquared =
            canopy.radius * canopy.radius;

        if (distanceSquared < radiusSquared) {

            const influence =
                1 - Math.sqrt(
                    distanceSquared / radiusSquared
                );

            shade += influence *
                this.shadingStrength *
                Math.min(1, canopy.height / 5);

        }

    }

    // Start with generous available light
    const intensity = BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(
        1.0 - shade * 0.35,
        0.15,
        1.0
    );

    return {
        direction: this.sunDirection,
        intensity
    };

}

}
export { Environment }

import { BrowserHeightmapLoader } from './topography/browser-heightmap-loader.js';
import { createHeightmapData, decodeHeightmapPixel, sampleHeightmapData, sampleNormalizedHeightmapData } from './topography/heightmap-data.js';

/** Compatibility terrain adapter for Babylon gameplay and chunk systems. */
class HeightmapTerrain {
    constructor(options = {}) {
        this.url = options.url ?? './assets/0_somnium_map_topographic.png';
        this.fallbackUrl = options.fallbackUrl ?? null;
        this.loadedSource = null;
        this.worldSize = options.worldSize ?? 1000000;
        this.minHeight = options.minHeight ?? -2000;
        this.maxHeight = options.maxHeight ?? 1000;
        this.heightChannel = options.heightChannel ?? 'average';
        this.min = { x: -this.worldSize / 2, y: this.minHeight, z: -this.worldSize / 2 };
        this.max = { x: this.worldSize / 2, y: this.maxHeight, z: this.worldSize / 2 };
        this.width = 0;
        this.height = 0;
        this.pixels = null;
        this.mapData = null;
        this.ready = false;
        this.diagnostics = null;
        this.loader = options.loader ?? new BrowserHeightmapLoader();
    }

    async load() {
        let mapData;
        this.loadedSource = this.url;
        try {
            const raster = await this.loader.load(this.url);
            assertCompleteRaster(raster, Boolean(this.fallbackUrl));
            mapData = this.createMapData(raster);
        } catch (error) {
            if (!this.fallbackUrl || this.fallbackUrl === this.url) throw error;
            console.warn(`[HeightmapTerrain] Primary map failed validation; loading fallback ${this.fallbackUrl}.`, error);
            mapData = this.createMapData(await this.loader.load(this.fallbackUrl));
            this.loadedSource = this.fallbackUrl;
        }
        this.mapData = mapData;
        this.width = this.mapData.width;
        this.height = this.mapData.height;
        this.pixels = this.mapData.pixels;
        this.ready = true;
        this.diagnostics = this.getDiagnostics(32);
        console.log('[HeightmapTerrain] Loaded:', this.diagnostics);
        return this;
    }

    createMapData(raster) {
        return createHeightmapData({
            ...raster,
            channel: this.heightChannel,
            minHeight: this.minHeight,
            maxHeight: this.maxHeight
        });
    }

    getNormalizedCoordinates(x, z) {
        return { u: (x - this.min.x) / this.worldSize, v: (z - this.min.z) / this.worldSize };
    }

    contains(x, z) {
        return x >= this.min.x && x <= this.max.x && z >= this.min.z && z <= this.max.z;
    }

    getPixelValue(x, z) {
        this.assertReady();
        const column = clamp(Math.floor(x), 0, this.width - 1);
        const row = clamp(Math.floor(z), 0, this.height - 1);
        return decodeHeightmapPixel(this.mapData, column, row);
    }

    getHeightPixel(x, z) { return this.getPixelValue(x, z); }

    sampleHeight(x, z) {
        this.assertReady();
        if (!this.contains(x, z)) return null;
        const coordinates = this.getNormalizedCoordinates(x, z);
        return sampleHeightmapData(this.mapData, coordinates.u, coordinates.v);
    }

    sampleMapValue(x, z) {
        this.assertReady();
        if (!this.contains(x, z)) return null;
        const coordinates = this.getNormalizedCoordinates(x, z);
        return sampleNormalizedHeightmapData(this.mapData, coordinates.u, coordinates.v);
    }

    sampleAt(x, z) {
        const height = this.sampleHeight(x, z);
        return height === null ? null : new BABYLON.Vector3(x, height, z);
    }

    sample() {
        return this.sampleAt(
            BABYLON.Scalar.RandomRange(this.min.x, this.max.x),
            BABYLON.Scalar.RandomRange(this.min.z, this.max.z)
        );
    }

    sampleNear(center, radius) {
        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const distance = radius * Math.sqrt(Math.random());
        return this.sampleAt(
            center.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
            center.z + Math.sin(angle) * distance
        );
    }

    sampleSlopeAt(x, z, spacing = 4) {
        const left = this.sampleHeight(x - spacing, z);
        const right = this.sampleHeight(x + spacing, z);
        const back = this.sampleHeight(x, z - spacing);
        const front = this.sampleHeight(x, z + spacing);
        if ([left, right, back, front].some(isNull)) return null;
        const dx = (right - left) / (2 * spacing);
        const dz = (front - back) / (2 * spacing);
        const magnitude = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        const angle = Math.atan(magnitude);
        return {
            gradientX: dx,
            gradientZ: dz,
            magnitude,
            angle,
            degrees: angle * 180 / Math.PI,
            normal: new BABYLON.Vector3(-dx, 1, -dz).normalize()
        };
    }

    sampleProfileAt(x, z, spacing = 4) {
        const position = this.sampleAt(x, z);
        const slope = this.sampleSlopeAt(x, z, spacing);
        if (!position || !slope) return null;
        return {
            position,
            elevation: clamp((position.y - this.minHeight) / (this.maxHeight - this.minHeight), 0, 1),
            slope: slope.magnitude,
            slopeDegrees: slope.degrees,
            normal: slope.normal
        };
    }

    getDiagnostics(gridSize = 32) {
        if (!this.ready) return { ready: false, message: 'Heightmap has not finished loading.' };
        const samples = Math.max(1, Math.floor(gridSize));
        let minimum = Infinity;
        let maximum = -Infinity;
        let total = 0;
        let count = 0;
        const extremaSamples = [];
        for (let row = 0; row <= samples; row++) {
            for (let column = 0; column <= samples; column++) {
                const x = this.min.x + column / samples * this.worldSize;
                const z = this.min.z + row / samples * this.worldSize;
                const height = this.sampleHeight(x, z);
                minimum = Math.min(minimum, height);
                maximum = Math.max(maximum, height);
                total += height;
                count++;
                if (isDiagnosticPoint(column, row, samples)) extremaSamples.push({ x, z, height });
            }
        }
        return {
            ready: true,
            image: { width: this.width, height: this.height },
            source: this.loadedSource,
            usingFallback: this.loadedSource !== this.url,
            worldSize: this.worldSize,
            heightChannel: this.heightChannel,
            configuredHeightRange: { min: this.minHeight, max: this.maxHeight },
            sampledHeightRange: { min: minimum, max: maximum, variation: maximum - minimum },
            averageHeight: total / count,
            sampleCount: count,
            samples: extremaSamples
        };
    }

    assertReady() {
        if (!this.ready || !this.mapData) throw new Error('Heightmap not loaded.');
    }

    dispose() {
        this.pixels = null;
        this.mapData = null;
        this.ready = false;
        this.diagnostics = null;
        this.loadedSource = null;
    }
}

function assertCompleteRaster(raster, checkTransparentTail) {
    if (!checkTransparentTail || !raster?.pixels || raster.height < 2) return;
    const threshold = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(raster.height * 0.01));
    let transparentRows = 0;
    for (let row = raster.height - 1; row >= 0; row--) {
        let transparent = true;
        for (let column = 0; column < raster.width; column++) {
            if (raster.pixels[(row * raster.width + column) * 4 + 3] !== 0) {
                transparent = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!transparent) break;
        transparentRows++;
    }
    if (transparentRows >= threshold) {
        throw new Error(`Topographic raster has ${transparentRows} fully transparent trailing rows.`);
    }
}

function isNull(value) { return value === null; }
function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) { return Math.min(maximum, Math.max(minimum, value)); }
function isDiagnosticPoint(column, row, size) {
    const midpoint = Math.floor(size / 2);
    return [0, midpoint, size].includes(column) && [0, midpoint, size].includes(row);
}

export { HeightmapTerrain };

class MoistureField {
    constructor(terrain, options = {}) {
        this.terrain = terrain;

        this.seaLevel = options.seaLevel ?? -100;

        this.baseMoisture = options.baseMoisture ?? 0.08;
        this.oceanMoisture = options.oceanMoisture ?? 0.82;

        this.coastalRadius = options.coastalRadius ?? 24000;
        this.atmosphericScale = options.atmosphericScale ?? 7000;

        this.cloudContribution = options.cloudContribution ?? 0.25;
    }

    clamp(value) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value));
    }

    getSurfaceHeight(x, z) {
        const height = this.terrain.sampleHeight(x, z);

        if (height === null || !Number.isFinite(height)) {
            return null;
        }

        return height;
    }

    getOceanInfluence(x, z) {
        const centerHeight = this.getSurfaceHeight(x, z);

        if (centerHeight === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Directly over the ocean.
        if (centerHeight <= this.seaLevel) {
            return 1;
        }

        // Sample the surrounding terrain to estimate
        // proximity to ocean water.
        const directions = [
            [1, 0],
            [-1, 0],
            [0, 1],
            [0, -1],
            [0.7071, 0.7071],
            [-0.7071, 0.7071],
            [0.7071, -0.7071],
            [-0.7071, -0.7071]
        ];

        let influence = 0;

        const distances = [
            this.coastalRadius * 0.4,
            this.coastalRadius
        ];

        for (let distanceIndex = 0;
             distanceIndex < distances.length;
             distanceIndex++) {

            const distance = distances[distanceIndex];

            const weight = distanceIndex === 0 ? 0.65 : 0.35;

            let oceanSamples = 0;

            for (const direction of directions) {
                const height = this.getSurfaceHeight(
                    x + direction[0] * distance,
                    z + direction[1] * distance
                );

                if (height !== null && height <= this.seaLevel) {
                    oceanSamples++;
                }
            }

            influence += (
                oceanSamples / directions.length
            ) * weight;
        }

        return this.clamp(influence);
    }

    sample(position, cloudMoisture = 0) {
        if (!position) {
            return this.baseMoisture;
        }

        const surfaceHeight = this.getSurfaceHeight(
            position.x,
            position.z
        );

        if (surfaceHeight === null) {
            return this.baseMoisture;
        }

        const referenceHeight = Math.max(
            surfaceHeight,
            this.seaLevel
        );

        const altitude = Math.max(
            0,
            position.y - referenceHeight
        );

        // Moisture availability decreases with altitude.
        const altitudeFactor = Math.exp(
            -altitude / this.atmosphericScale
        );

        const oceanInfluence = this.getOceanInfluence(
            position.x,
            position.z
        );

        const oceanContribution =
            oceanInfluence *
            this.oceanMoisture *
            altitudeFactor;

        const cloudContribution =
            this.clamp(cloudMoisture) *
            this.cloudContribution;

        return this.clamp(
            this.baseMoisture +
            oceanContribution +
            cloudContribution
        );
    }

    sampleSurface(x, z) {
        const position = {
            x,
            y: this.seaLevel,
            z
        };

        return this.sample(position);
    }

    getStats() {
        return {
            seaLevel: this.seaLevel,
            baseMoisture: this.baseMoisture,
            oceanMoisture: this.oceanMoisture,
            coastalRadius: this.coastalRadius,
            atmosphericScale: this.atmosphericScale
        };
    }
}

export { MoistureField };

class SpatialGrid {

    constructor(cellSize = 2.5) {

        this.cellSize = cellSize;
        this.cells = new Map();

    }

    getKey(x, z) {

        const cx = Math.floor(x / this.cellSize);
        const cz = Math.floor(z / this.cellSize);

        return `${cx},${cz}`;
    }

    insert(tree) {

        const key = this.getKey(
            tree.position.x,
            tree.position.z
        );

        if (!this.cells.has(key)) {
            this.cells.set(key, []);
        }

        this.cells.get(key).push(tree);

    }

    isAvailable(position, minSpacing) {

        const cx = Math.floor(
            position.x / this.cellSize
        );

        const cz = Math.floor(
            position.z / this.cellSize
        );

        const searchRadius = Math.ceil(
            minSpacing / this.cellSize
        );

        const minSpacingSquared =
            minSpacing * minSpacing;

        for (
            let x = cx - searchRadius;
            x <= cx + searchRadius;
            x++
        ) {

            for (
                let z = cz - searchRadius;
                z <= cz + searchRadius;
                z++
            ) {

                const key = `${x},${z}`;
                const cell = this.cells.get(key);

                if (!cell) continue;

                for (const tree of cell) {

                    if (!tree.alive) continue;

                    const dx =
                        position.x - tree.position.x;

                    const dz =
                        position.z - tree.position.z;

                    if (
                        dx * dx + dz * dz <
                        minSpacingSquared
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                }

            }

        }

        return true;

    }

}
export { SpatialGrid }

class TerrainSampler {

    constructor(scene, ground) {

        this.scene = scene;
        this.ground = ground;

        ground.isPickable = true;
        ground.computeWorldMatrix(true);

        const bounds = ground.getBoundingInfo().boundingBox;

        this.min = bounds.minimumWorld.clone();
        this.max = bounds.maximumWorld.clone();
    }


    sample() {

        const x = BABYLON.Scalar.RandomRange(
            this.min.x,
            this.max.x
        );

        const z = BABYLON.Scalar.RandomRange(
            this.min.z,
            this.max.z
        );

        const origin = new BABYLON.Vector3(
            x,
            this.max.y + 100,
            z
        );

        const ray = new BABYLON.Ray(
            origin,
            new BABYLON.Vector3(0, -1, 0),
            this.max.y - this.min.y + 200
        );

        const hit = this.scene.pickWithRay(
            ray,
            mesh => mesh === this.ground,
            true
        );

        if (!hit || !hit.hit || !hit.pickedPoint) {
            return null;
        }

        return hit.pickedPoint.clone();
    }


	
sampleNear(center, radius) {

    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

    // Uniform distribution over a circular area
    const distance = radius * Math.sqrt(Math.random());

    const x = center.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance;
    const z = center.z + Math.sin(angle) * distance;

    return this.sampleAt(x, z);
}


sampleAt(x, z) {

    if (
        x < this.min.x || x > this.max.x ||
        z < this.min.z || z > this.max.z
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    const origin = new BABYLON.Vector3(
        x,
        this.max.y + 100,
        z
    );

    const ray = new BABYLON.Ray(
        origin,
        new BABYLON.Vector3(0, -1, 0),
        this.max.y - this.min.y + 200
    );

    const hit = this.scene.pickWithRay(
        ray,
        mesh => mesh === this.ground,
        true
    );

    if (!hit || !hit.hit || !hit.pickedPoint) {
        return null;
    }

    return hit.pickedPoint.clone();
}


sampleSlopeAt(x, z, spacing = 4) {

    const left = this.sampleAt(
        x - spacing,
        z
    );

    const right = this.sampleAt(
        x + spacing,
        z
    );

    const back = this.sampleAt(
        x,
        z - spacing
    );

    const front = this.sampleAt(
        x,
        z + spacing
    );

    if (!left || !right || !back || !front) {
        return null;
    }

    const dx = (
        right.y - left.y
    ) / (spacing * 2);

    const dz = (
        front.y - back.y
    ) / (spacing * 2);

    const magnitude = Math.sqrt(
        dx * dx + dz * dz
    );

    const angle = Math.atan(magnitude);

    return {

        gradientX: dx,

        gradientZ: dz,

        magnitude,

        angle,

        degrees: angle * 180 / Math.PI,

        normal: new BABYLON.Vector3(
            -dx,
            1,
            -dz
        ).normalize()

    };

}


sampleProfileAt(x, z, spacing = 4) {

    const position = this.sampleAt(x, z);

    if (!position) return null;

    const slope = this.sampleSlopeAt(
        x,
        z,
        spacing
    );

    if (!slope) return null;

    const elevation = BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(

        (position.y - this.min.y) /
        Math.max(1, this.max.y - this.min.y),

        0,
        1

    );

    return {

        position,

        elevation,

        slope: slope.magnitude,

        slopeDegrees: slope.degrees,

        normal: slope.normal

    };

}



}
export { TerrainSampler }

/** Browser-only image decoding adapter. It returns plain RGBA raster data. */

class BrowserHeightmapLoader {
    async load(source, options = {}) {
        if (isImageData(source)) return copyImageData(source);
        if (typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
            return this.loadImageBitmap(source, options);
        }
        return this.loadHtmlImage(source, options);
    }

    async loadImageBitmap(source, options) {
        let bitmap;
        try {
            bitmap = await createImageBitmap(await resolveImageSource(source));
            return this.readBitmap(bitmap, options);
        } catch (error) {
            throw createLoadError(source, error);
        } finally {
            bitmap?.close?.();
        }
    }

    readBitmap(bitmap, options) {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = bitmap.width;
        canvas.height = bitmap.height;
        const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
        if (!context) throw new Error('Unable to create a heightmap canvas context.');
        context.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0);
        return copyImageData(context.getImageData(0, 0, bitmap.width, bitmap.height), options);
    }

    async loadHtmlImage(source, options) {
        if (typeof source !== 'string') {
            throw new TypeError('This browser requires an image URL when createImageBitmap is unavailable.');
        }
        const image = new Image();
        image.crossOrigin = options.crossOrigin ?? 'anonymous';
        const loaded = new Promise(resolveImageLoad.bind(null, image));
        image.src = source;
        try {
            await loaded;
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = image.naturalWidth;
            canvas.height = image.naturalHeight;
            const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
            if (!context) throw new Error('Unable to create a heightmap canvas context.');
            context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
            return copyImageData(context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height), options);
        } catch (error) {
            throw createLoadError(source, error);
        }
    }
}

async function resolveImageSource(source) {
    if (typeof source === 'string') {
        const response = await fetch(source, { mode: 'cors' });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} while loading map.`);
        return response.blob();
    }
    if (source instanceof Blob) return source;
    throw new TypeError('Heightmap source must be a URL, Blob, File, or ImageData.');
}

function isImageData(value) {
    return Boolean(value && Number.isSafeInteger(value.width) &&
        Number.isSafeInteger(value.height) && value.data);
}

function copyImageData(imageData) {
    return {
        width: imageData.width,
        height: imageData.height,
        pixels: new Uint8Array(imageData.data)
    };
}

function resolveImageLoad(image, resolve, reject) {
    image.onload = resolve;
    image.onerror = reject;
}

function createLoadError(source, error) {
    const label = typeof source === 'string' ? source : 'provided image data';
    return new Error(`Unable to decode topographic map ${label}: ${error.message}`, { cause: error });
}

export { BrowserHeightmapLoader };

src/environment/topography/heightmap-data.js

/** Pure raster validation, elevation decoding, and bilinear sampling. */

const CHANNELS = new Set([
    'red', 'green', 'blue', 'alpha', 'average', 'luminance'
]);

function createHeightmapData(options = {}) {
    const width = options.width;
    const height = options.height;
    const pixels = options.pixels ?? options.data;
    const channel = options.channel ?? 'luminance';
    const minHeight = options.minHeight ?? 0;
    const maxHeight = options.maxHeight ?? 1;
    const colorStops = normalizeColorStops(options.colorStops);

    validateRaster(width, height, pixels);
    validateHeightRange(minHeight, maxHeight);
    validateChannel(channel, colorStops);

    return {
        width,
        height,
        pixels: new Uint8Array(pixels),
        channel,
        minHeight,
        maxHeight,
        colorStops
    };
}

function validateRaster(width, height, pixels) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(width) || width < 2) {
        throw new RangeError('Heightmap width must be an integer of at least two.');
    }
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(height) || height < 2) {
        throw new RangeError('Heightmap height must be an integer of at least two.');
    }
    if (!pixels || !Number.isSafeInteger(pixels.length)) {
        throw new TypeError('Heightmap pixels must be a typed or array-like RGBA buffer.');
    }
    if (pixels.length !== width * height * 4) {
        throw new RangeError('Heightmap RGBA buffer length does not match its dimensions.');
    }
    for (let index = 0; index < pixels.length; index++) {
        const value = pixels[index];
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 255) {
            throw new RangeError(`Heightmap pixel ${index} is outside the byte range.`);
        }
    }
}

function validateHeightRange(minHeight, maxHeight) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(minHeight) || !Number.isFinite(maxHeight) || minHeight >= maxHeight) {
        throw new RangeError('Heightmap elevation bounds must be finite and increasing.');
    }
}

function validateChannel(channel, colorStops) {
    if (colorStops.length) return;
    if (!CHANNELS.has(channel)) {
        throw new RangeError(`Unsupported heightmap channel: ${channel}`);
    }
}

function normalizeColorStops(stops = []) {
    if (!Array.isArray(stops)) {
        throw new TypeError('Heightmap colorStops must be an array.');
    }
    const normalized = stops.map(normalizeColorStop);
    if (normalized.length && normalized.length < 2) {
        throw new RangeError('A color elevation palette requires at least two stops.');
    }
    return normalized;
}

function normalizeColorStop(stop) {
    if (!stop || !Array.isArray(stop.color) || stop.color.length < 3) {
        throw new TypeError('Each color stop requires an RGB color and normalized value.');
    }
    const color = stop.color.slice(0, 3);
    if (!color.every(isByte)) throw new RangeError('Palette RGB channels must be bytes.');
    if (!Number.isFinite(stop.value) || stop.value < 0 || stop.value > 1) {
        throw new RangeError('Palette values must be normalized to [0, 1].');
    }
    return { color, value: stop.value };
}

function isByte(value) {
    return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 255;
}

function sampleHeightmapData(data, u, v) {
    return data.minHeight + sampleNormalizedHeightmapData(data, u, v) * (data.maxHeight - data.minHeight);
}

function sampleNormalizedHeightmapData(data, u, v) {
    validateSampleCoordinates(u, v);
    const x = clamp(u, 0, 1) * (data.width - 1);
    const z = clamp(v, 0, 1) * (data.height - 1);
    const x0 = Math.floor(x);
    const z0 = Math.floor(z);
    const x1 = Math.min(x0 + 1, data.width - 1);
    const z1 = Math.min(z0 + 1, data.height - 1);
    const tx = x - x0;
    const tz = z - z0;
    const top = lerp(
        decodeHeightmapPixel(data, x0, z0),
        decodeHeightmapPixel(data, x1, z0),
        tx
    );
    const bottom = lerp(
        decodeHeightmapPixel(data, x0, z1),
        decodeHeightmapPixel(data, x1, z1),
        tx
    );
    return lerp(top, bottom, tz);
}

function decodeHeightmapPixel(data, x, z) {
    const offset = (z * data.width + x) * 4;
    const pixels = data.pixels;
    if (data.colorStops.length) return decodePalette(pixels, offset, data.colorStops);

    const red = pixels[offset];
    const green = pixels[offset + 1];
    const blue = pixels[offset + 2];
    const alpha = pixels[offset + 3];
    switch (data.channel) {
        case 'red': return red / 255;
        case 'green': return green / 255;
        case 'blue': return blue / 255;
        case 'alpha': return alpha / 255;
        case 'average': return (red + green + blue) / 765;
        default: return (0.2126 * red + 0.7152 * green + 0.0722 * blue) / 255;
    }
}

function decodePalette(pixels, offset, stops) {
    let nearest = stops[0];
    let nearestDistance = Infinity;
    for (const stop of stops) {
        const red = pixels[offset] - stop.color[0];
        const green = pixels[offset + 1] - stop.color[1];
        const blue = pixels[offset + 2] - stop.color[2];
        const distance = red * red + green * green + blue * blue;
        if (distance < nearestDistance) {
            nearest = stop;
            nearestDistance = distance;
        }
    }
    return nearest.value;
}

function validateSampleCoordinates(u, v) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(u) || !Number.isFinite(v)) {
        throw new TypeError('Heightmap sample coordinates must be finite.');
    }
}

function clamp(value, minimum, maximum) {
    return Math.min(maximum, Math.max(minimum, value));
}

function lerp(start, end, amount) {
    return start + (end - start) * amount;
}

function getHeightmapStatistics(data, samples = 24) {
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(samples) || samples < 1) {
        throw new RangeError('Heightmap statistic sample count must be positive.');
    }
    let minimum = Infinity;
    let maximum = -Infinity;
    let total = 0;
    let count = 0;
    for (let row = 0; row <= samples; row++) {
        for (let column = 0; column <= samples; column++) {
            const value = sampleHeightmapData(data, column / samples, row / samples);
            minimum = Math.min(minimum, value);
            maximum = Math.max(maximum, value);
            total += value;
            count++;
        }
    }
    return { minimum, maximum, average: total / count, count };
}

export {
    createHeightmapData,
    decodeHeightmapPixel,
    getHeightmapStatistics,
    sampleHeightmapData,
    sampleNormalizedHeightmapData
};

/**
 * Character-follow camera shared by the main world and anomaly-connected
 * geometry demo. Camera distance is expressed in render units so a change of
 * spatial chart (for example Euclidean -> Poincare) does not collapse zoom.
 */

class CharacterCameraController {
    constructor(scene, camera, character, spatialTransform, options = {}) {
        this.scene = scene;
        this.camera = camera;
        this.character = character;
        this.transform = spatialTransform;

        const initialHorizontalDistance = options.distance ?? 24;
        this.height = options.height ?? 8;
        this.targetHeight = options.targetHeight ?? 1.3;
        const initialVerticalOffset = this.height - this.targetHeight;
        this.distance = Math.hypot(initialHorizontalDistance, initialVerticalOffset);
        this.minDistance = options.minDistance ?? 2.5;
        this.maxDistance = options.maxDistance ?? 1200;
        this.zoomSensitivity = options.zoomSensitivity ?? 0.001;
        this.smoothing = options.smoothing ?? 8;
        this.orbitYaw = options.orbitYaw ?? 0;
        this.orbitPitch = options.orbitPitch ?? Math.atan2(
            initialVerticalOffset,
            Math.max(initialHorizontalDistance, 1e-9)
        );
        this.orbitSensitivity = options.orbitSensitivity ?? 0.005;
        this.orbitButton = options.orbitButton ?? 2;
        this.enabled = false;
        this.disposed = false;
        this.renderAnchor = null;
        this.orbitDragging = false;
        this.previousOrbitPointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };

        this.onWheel = this.handleWheel.bind(this);
        this.onOrbitPointerDown = this.handleOrbitPointerDown.bind(this);
        this.onOrbitPointerMove = this.handleOrbitPointerMove.bind(this);
        this.onOrbitPointerUp = this.handleOrbitPointerUp.bind(this);
        this.onBlur = this.handleBlur.bind(this);
        this.onContextMenu = this.handleContextMenu.bind(this);

        this.canvas = scene.getEngine().getRenderingCanvas();
        this.window = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : null;
        if (this.canvas) {
            this.canvas.addEventListener('wheel', this.onWheel, { passive: false });
            this.canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.onOrbitPointerDown);
            this.canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', this.onContextMenu);
        }
        this.window?.addEventListener('pointermove', this.onOrbitPointerMove);
        this.window?.addEventListener('pointerup', this.onOrbitPointerUp);
        this.window?.addEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
    }

    handleWheel(event) {
        if (!this.enabled || this.disposed) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        this.distance = BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(
            this.distance * Math.exp(event.deltaY * this.zoomSensitivity),
            this.minDistance,
            this.maxDistance
        );
    }

    handleOrbitPointerDown(event) {
        if (!this.enabled || this.disposed || this.mode === 'free' || event.button !== this.orbitButton) return;
        this.orbitDragging = true;
        this.previousOrbitPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
        event.preventDefault();
    }

    handleOrbitPointerMove(event) {
        if (!this.orbitDragging || !this.enabled || this.disposed || this.mode === 'free') return;
        const deltaX = event.clientX - this.previousOrbitPointer.x;
        const deltaY = event.clientY - this.previousOrbitPointer.y;
        this.orbitYaw += deltaX * this.orbitSensitivity;
        // Deliberately unbounded: dragging can orbit through the poles and
        // continue around the character without arbitrary pitch cutoffs.
        this.orbitPitch -= deltaY * this.orbitSensitivity;
        this.previousOrbitPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    }

    handleOrbitPointerUp() {
        this.orbitDragging = false;
    }

    handleBlur() {
        this.orbitDragging = false;
    }

    handleContextMenu(event) {
        if (this.enabled && !this.disposed && event.button === this.orbitButton) {
            event.preventDefault();
        }
    }

    setSpatialContext(transform, layerMask) {
        this.transform = transform;
        if (Number.isSafeInteger(layerMask)) this.camera.layerMask = layerMask;
    }

    setRenderAnchor(position, yaw, target = null) {
        this.renderAnchor = { position: { ...position }, yaw, target: target ? { ...target } : null };
    }

    clearRenderAnchor() {
        this.renderAnchor = null;
    }

    getTargetPosition() {
        if (this.renderAnchor) {
            return this.renderAnchor.target
                ? { ...this.renderAnchor.target }
                : { ...this.renderAnchor.position, y: this.renderAnchor.position.y + this.targetHeight };
        }

        const playerWorld = this.character.worldPosition;
        const playerRender = this.transform.worldToRender(playerWorld);
        const visualScale = this.transform.getVisualScale?.(playerWorld) ??
            this.character.root?.scaling?.y ?? 1;
        const focusOffset = this.targetHeight * Math.max(1e-6, visualScale);
        return {
            x: playerRender.x,
            y: playerRender.y + focusOffset,
            z: playerRender.z
        };
    }

    getCameraYaw() {
        const anchoredYaw = this.renderAnchor?.yaw;
        const baseYaw = Number.isFinite(anchoredYaw) ? anchoredYaw : (this.character?.yaw ?? 0);
        return baseYaw + this.orbitYaw;
    }

    getCameraAnchorPosition() {
        if (this.renderAnchor) return { ...this.renderAnchor.position };
        return this.transform.worldToRender(this.character.worldPosition);
    }

    getDesiredPosition() {
        const target = this.getTargetPosition();
        const anchor = this.renderAnchor ? this.getCameraAnchorPosition() : target;
        const yaw = this.getCameraYaw();
        const horizontalDistance = this.distance * Math.cos(this.orbitPitch);
        const verticalDistance = this.distance * Math.sin(this.orbitPitch) +
            (this.renderAnchor ? this.targetHeight : 0);
        const desired = {
            x: anchor.x - Math.sin(yaw) * horizontalDistance,
            y: anchor.y + verticalDistance,
            z: anchor.z - Math.cos(yaw) * horizontalDistance
        };
        // A camera is still a point in the active render chart. Keep it inside
        // an open Poincare ball without changing the character's world pose.
        return this.transform.constrainRenderPosition?.(desired) ?? desired;
    }

    applyCameraPose(position, target) {
        const yaw = this.getCameraYaw();
        const pitch = this.orbitPitch;
        // This tangent up-vector remains continuous as pitch passes over either
        // pole, avoiding an artificial camera-angle clamp or sudden roll flip.
        const up = new BABYLON.Vector3(
            Math.sin(yaw) * Math.sin(pitch),
            Math.cos(pitch),
            Math.cos(yaw) * Math.sin(pitch)
        );
        if (this.camera.upVector?.copyFrom) this.camera.upVector.copyFrom(up);
        else this.camera.upVector = up;
        this.camera.setTarget(new BABYLON.Vector3(target.x, target.y, target.z));
    }

    update(deltaSeconds) {
        if (!this.enabled || this.disposed) return;
        const desired = this.getDesiredPosition();
        const target = this.getTargetPosition();
        const alpha = 1 - Math.exp(-this.smoothing * Math.max(0, deltaSeconds));
        const desiredVector = new BABYLON.Vector3(desired.x, desired.y, desired.z);
        BABYLON.Vector3.LerpToRef(this.camera.position, desiredVector, alpha, this.camera.position);
        this.applyCameraPose(this.camera.position, target);
    }

    setEnabled(enabled) {
        this.enabled = Boolean(enabled) && !this.disposed;
        if (!this.enabled) {
            this.orbitDragging = false;
            return;
        }
        const desired = this.getDesiredPosition();
        this.camera.position.set(desired.x, desired.y, desired.z);
        this.applyCameraPose(this.camera.position, this.getTargetPosition());
    }

    setDistance(distance) {
        this.distance = BABYLON.Scalar.Clamp(distance, this.minDistance, this.maxDistance);
    }

    getZoomInfo() {
        return {
            distance: this.distance,
            minDistance: this.minDistance,
            maxDistance: this.maxDistance,
            orbitYaw: this.orbitYaw,
            orbitPitch: this.orbitPitch
        };
    }

    dispose() {
        if (this.disposed) return;
        this.disposed = true;
        this.enabled = false;
        this.orbitDragging = false;
        if (this.canvas) {
            this.canvas.removeEventListener('wheel', this.onWheel);
            this.canvas.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.onOrbitPointerDown);
            this.canvas.removeEventListener('contextmenu', this.onContextMenu);
        }
        this.window?.removeEventListener('pointermove', this.onOrbitPointerMove);
        this.window?.removeEventListener('pointerup', this.onOrbitPointerUp);
        this.window?.removeEventListener('blur', this.onBlur);
        this.renderAnchor = null;
        this.camera = null;
        this.character = null;
    }
}

export { CharacterCameraController };

src/game/dnd-action-registry.js

class DnDActionRegistry {
    constructor() {
        this.handlers = new Map();
    }

    register(type, handler) {
        if (
            typeof type !== "string" ||
            !type.trim()
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Handler type is required."
            );
        }

        if (typeof handler !== "function") {
            throw new Error(
                "Handler must be a function."
            );
        }

        if (this.handlers.has(type)) {
            throw new Error(
                `Handler already registered: ${type}`
            );
        }

        this.handlers.set(type, handler);

        return () => this.unregister(type);
    }

    unregister(type) {
        return this.handlers.delete(type);
    }

    has(type) {
        return this.handlers.has(type) ||
            this.handlers.has("*");
    }

    async dispatch(context, payload) {
        if (
            !payload ||
            typeof payload !== "object" ||
            Array.isArray(payload)
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Action payload must be a JSON object."
            );
        }

        const type = payload.type;

        if (
            typeof type !== "string" ||
            !type.trim()
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                "Generic actions require a type field."
            );
        }

        const handler =
            this.handlers.get(type) ||
            this.handlers.get("*");

        if (!handler) {
            throw new Error(
                `No handler registered for: ${type}`
            );
        }

        const safePayload = JSON.parse(
            JSON.stringify(payload)
        );

        return handler({
            ...context,
            payload: safePayload
        });
    }
}

export { DnDActionRegistry };


src/game/dnd-battle.js
